$comment: Readable action-by-action contract for the Crawl Orchestrator flow. NOT a direct import artifact (connection references and environment IDs are tenant-specific). Rebuild in the maker portal following flows/crawl-orchestrator/README.md, or use this as the map when authoring the definition.

actions.name: Compose_Ruleset
actions.note: Shape rules into the engine Ruleset; parse bvr_parametersjson via json().

actions.name: List_Environments
actions.note: Enumerate tenant environments via the BAP API so every environment is known up front (not just those a flow already turned up in). Shape the response with the engine's parseEnvironments(); use environmentLabel(env) as the bvr_environment value. Needs the application user / SPN to have tenant environment-reader access. Omit this step and the loop below to crawl only the home environment.

actions.name: Apply_to_each_environment
actions.note: Iterate environments so flows across the tenant are reviewed and tagged with their environment. For the home (Dataverse) environment, List_Cloud_Flows from the 'workflows' table; for other environments list flows via the Power Automate Management API for that environment id. Set bvr_environment on every inventory upsert to the current environment's display name so the web resource's Environment filter lists them.

actions.name: List_Cloud_Flows
actions.$filterNote: Reviews only activated flows (statecode eq 1) unless the active standard's 'Review all flows' (bvr_reviewallflows) is on, in which case every cloud flow is listed.
actions.environmentNote: Home environment uses the Dataverse 'workflows' table; for other environments substitute a Management API 'list flows' call scoped to @items('Apply_to_each_environment')?['name'].

actions.name: Enrich_From_Management_API
actions.note: Power Automate Management API for owner principal type and state (environment comes from the enumerated environment).

actions.name: Skip_If_Unchanged
actions.note: Compare bvr_definitionhash to prior run; skip engine call if identical.

actions.name: Review_Flow
actions.note: Ember review Custom API (Dataverse plug-in) — replaces the custom connector; the review runs in-platform, no external hosting. Result is a JSON string in body('Review_Flow')?['Result'].

actions.name: Parse_Review
actions.note: Parse the Result JSON once, then read score/findings from it.
